Class DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.servlet.handler.AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver
org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Ordered, HandlerExceptionResolver
public class DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver extends AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver
The default implementation of the HandlerExceptionResolver interface, resolving standard Spring MVC exceptions and translating them to corresponding HTTP status codes.

此异常解析器在通用的 Spring DispatcherServlet 中默认启用。

支持的异常

Exception HTTP Status Code
HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException
405 (SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED)
HttpMediaTypeNotSupportedException
415 (SC_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE)
HttpMediaTypeNotAcceptableException
406 (SC_NOT_ACCEPTABLE)
MissingPathVariableException
500 (SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
MissingServletRequestParameterException
400 (SC_BAD_REQUEST)
MissingServletRequestPartException
400 (SC_BAD_REQUEST)
ServletRequestBindingException
400 (SC_BAD_REQUEST)
ConversionNotSupportedException
500 (SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
TypeMismatchException
400 (SC_BAD_REQUEST)
HttpMessageNotReadableException
400 (SC_BAD_REQUEST)
HttpMessageNotWritableException
500 (SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
MethodArgumentNotValidException
400 (SC_BAD_REQUEST)
MethodValidationException
500 (SC_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
HandlerMethodValidationException
400 (SC_BAD_REQUEST)
NoHandlerFoundException
404 (SC_NOT_FOUND)
NoResourceFoundException
404 (SC_NOT_FOUND)
AsyncRequestTimeoutException
503 (SC_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
AsyncRequestNotUsableException
不适用

  • Method Details

    • doResolveException

      protected @Nullable ModelAndView doResolveException(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response, @Nullable Object handler, Exception ex)
      描述从类复制：AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver
      Actually resolve the given exception that got thrown during handler execution, returning a ModelAndView that represents a specific error page if appropriate.

      可在子类中重写，以应用特定的异常检查。请注意，此模板方法将在检查此解析器是否适用（如"mappedHandlers"等）之后被调用，因此实现可以直接进行实际的异常处理。

      Specified by:
      `doResolveException` 在类 `AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver` 中
      Parameters:
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      response - 当前 HTTP 响应
      handler - 已执行的处理器，或者如果在异常发生当时未选择任何处理器（例如，多部分解析失败）则为 null
      ex - 在处理器执行期间抛出的异常
      Returns:
      一个用于转发的对应 `ModelAndView`，或为解析链中的默认处理而设置的 `null`。

    • handleHttpRequestMethodNotSupported

      protected @Nullable ModelAndView handleHttpRequestMethodNotSupported(HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException ex, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response, @Nullable Object handler) throws IOException
      Handle the case where no handler was found for the HTTP method.

      默认实现返回 `null`，此时异常将在 handleErrorResponse(ErrorResponse, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Object) 中处理。

      Parameters:
      ex - 要处理的 HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      response - 当前 HTTP 响应
      handler - 已执行的处理器，或者在发生异常时未选择任何处理器（例如，如果多部分解析失败）则为 null
      Returns:
      一个空的 `ModelAndView` 表示异常已得到处理，或 `null` 表示应在 handleErrorResponse(ErrorResponse, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Object) 中处理该异常。
      Throws:
      IOException - 可能由 HttpServletResponse.sendError(int, String) 抛出

      Handle an Exception that indicates the client has gone away. This is typically an IOException of a specific subtype or with a message specific to the underlying Servlet container. Those are detected through DisconnectedClientHelper.isClientDisconnectedException(Throwable)

      默认情况下，由于响应不可用，因此不执行任何操作。

      Parameters:
      ex - 要处理的 Exception
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      response - 当前 HTTP 响应
      handler - 已执行的处理器，或者在发生异常时未选择任何处理器（例如，如果多部分解析失败）则为 null
      Returns:
      一个空的 ModelAndView，表示该异常已被处理。
      Since:
      6.2

    • handleErrorResponse

      protected ModelAndView handleErrorResponse(ErrorResponse errorResponse, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response, @Nullable Object handler) throws IOException
      Handle an ErrorResponse exception.

      默认实现将响应状态和标头设置为从 `ErrorResponse` 获取的值。如果可用，则使用 ProblemDetail.getDetail() 作为 HttpServletResponse.sendError(int, String) 的消息。

      Parameters:
      errorResponse - 要处理的异常
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      response - 当前 HTTP 响应
      handler - 已执行的处理器
      Returns:
      一个空的ModelAndView，表示该异常已被处理。
      Throws:
      IOException - 可能由 HttpServletResponse.sendError(int, String) 抛出
      Since:
      6.0

    • handleConversionNotSupported

      protected ModelAndView handleConversionNotSupported(ConversionNotSupportedException ex, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response, @Nullable Object handler) throws IOException

      Returns:
      一个空的ModelAndView，表示该异常已被处理。
      Throws:
      IOException - 可能由 HttpServletResponse.sendError(int, String) 抛出

    • logException

      protected void logException(Exception ex, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request)
      描述从类复制：AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver
      Log the given exception at warn level, provided that warn logging has been activated through the "warnLogCategory" property.

      调用AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver.buildLogMessage(Exception, HttpServletRequest)以确定要记录的具体消息。

      Overrides:
      `logException` 类中的 `AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver`
      Parameters:
      ex - 在处理器执行期间抛出的异常
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求（可用于获取元数据）
      See Also:
      • AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver.setWarnLogCategory(String)
      • AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver.buildLogMessage(Exception, HttpServletRequest)
      • Log.warn(Object, Throwable)
